description: Synthetic prior-clause / new-clause pairs with the expected diff status.

prior.text: Stock brokers shall appoint a Compliance Officer.

cases.clause: Stock brokers shall implement two-factor authentication for all client logins by 2026-09-30.

prior.text: Stock brokers shall submit a monthly reconciliation statement to the Exchange.

cases.clause: Every stock broker shall conduct an annual cyber security audit through a CERT-In empanelled auditor.

prior.text: Brokers shall maintain client order records for five years.
Brokers shall display grievance contact details on their website.

cases.clause: Stock brokers shall report any cyber incident to the Exchange within six hours.

prior.text: Stock brokers shall pay the annual registration fee by 30 November.

cases.clause: Stock brokers shall run a quarterly investor awareness programme for retail clients.

prior.text: Stock brokers shall submit a monthly reconciliation statement to the Exchange by the 7th of the following month.

cases.clause: Stock brokers shall submit a monthly reconciliation statement to the Exchange by the 7th of the following month.

prior.text: Every stock broker shall appoint a Compliance Officer and intimate the Exchange.

cases.clause: Every stock broker must appoint a Compliance Officer and intimate the Exchange of the appointment.

prior.text: Brokers shall retain trade confirmations and order records for a minimum of five years.

cases.clause: Brokers shall retain records of trade confirmations and orders for at least five years.

prior.text: Stock brokers shall obtain an annual net worth certificate from a chartered accountant.

cases.clause: Stock brokers shall obtain a net worth certificate from a chartered accountant every year.

prior.text: Stock brokers shall submit the reconciliation statement to the Exchange quarterly.

cases.clause: Stock brokers shall submit the reconciliation statement to the Exchange monthly.

prior.text: Stock brokers shall report cyber incidents to the Exchange within 24 hours.

cases.clause: Stock brokers shall report cyber incidents to the Exchange within six hours.

prior.text: Stock brokers shall retain order records for three years.

cases.clause: Stock brokers shall retain order records for five years.

prior.text: Brokers with more than 10,000 active clients shall conduct an annual system audit.

cases.clause: All brokers, irrespective of client count, shall conduct an annual system audit.

prior.text: Stock brokers shall file the annual compliance certificate by 30 June.

cases.clause: Stock brokers shall file the annual compliance certificate by 31 May.

prior.text: Stock brokers shall submit a quarterly risk report to the Exchange.

cases.clause: In supersession of the earlier requirement for quarterly risk reports, stock brokers shall submit a monthly risk dashboard to the Exchange.

prior.text: Brokers shall use the legacy client registration form CR-1.

cases.clause: The legacy client registration form CR-1 is withdrawn and replaced by the unified KYC form; brokers shall use only the unified KYC form.

prior.text: Stock brokers shall display grievance contact details on their notice board.

cases.clause: This clause replaces the earlier direction on notice-board display; stock brokers shall now publish grievance contact details on their website and mobile app.
